summary: Defines a MIB module extending the Interfaces Group MIB with common objects for managing multi-pair bonded xDSL interfaces, as defined in ITU-T Recommendations G.998.1, G.998.2, and G.998.3. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Sometimes several phone wires are tied together to carry data faster. This memo defines a standard set of dials for checking and controlling such a bundle.

questions: managing bonded dsl interfaces with snmp
